reason: 该插件的主要面向是 DeepSeek Harness 用户界面增强：在输入区下方的模型入口加入可操控的推理强度滑块，并按模型公开的 effort 档位展示与选择选项；README 还说明它与 `/model` 命令/会话状态保持同步、支持主题与外观开关，并为缺少档位声明的自定义模型输出可复制的配置片段。其能力集中在客户端模型选择交互与配置辅助，未体现独立系统级操作或额外外部服务接入。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在会话页面的模型入口中加入可拖拽的“模型 + 推理强度”控件，并基于当前模型公开的档位进行选择与同步。
summaries.en: This DeepSeek Harness plugin adds a drag-based model-and-reasoning-effort control to the chat interface, letting users pick effort levels based on each model’s advertised options and keep them aligned with current session selection.

capabilities: Adds a custom model-selection UI control in the DSH web interface, including a drag-based reasoning-effort slider.
Reads model-declared effort options and renders selectable levels from the active model configuration.
Syncs the selected reasoning effort with DSH `/model` state and session model selection.
Provides copy-ready configuration snippets for custom providers when effort levels are not discovered from upstream model metadata.
Persists interface toggles (slider/enhanced control and optional themed appearance) in the browser.
